name: Louder Than Words ~The Story of a Field Trip~
source: Louder Than Words tells a dramatic coming of age story, following Teijo's path as he enters the adult world and faces its different hurdles, as well as the innocent relationships at school, which soon turn to serious commitments later in life.
translation: 《Louder Than Words》讲述了一个充满波折的成长故事。泰约逐步踏入成人世界，面对种种难关，而校园里那些纯真的感情，也将在日后的人生中化为郑重的承诺。
